title: Lulu and the Little Lamb | Bedtime Story for Kids
description:
Lulu hops over a little brook, but Little Lamb is not sure. It looks too big!
Lulu hops back: let's try together. One, two, three... hop! Little Lamb did it!
They play in the meadow and sleep side by side under the moon.
A calm bedtime story about being brave, for children aged 3 to 6.
